response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, full-stack senior engineer with strong software craftsmanship and leadership/mentoring signals (talks, workshops, open source), but the role's hard requirements around deep C++ (8 years), large-scale distributed/compute infrastructure, and cloud platform architecture are not substantiated in his history. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint and a student project, and his recent career is focused on web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than cloud compute platforms or infrastructure at scale.
strengths: Extensive senior-level engineering experience across many domains and companies
Demonstrated mentoring, teaching, and community leadership (workshops, talks, open source)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) and far short of the 8-year requirement
No evidence of large-scale distributed systems, cloud compute platform, or infrastructure architecture work
Career trajectory is generalist/full-stack web development, not specialized cloud/compute technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/distributed infrastructure background
